api.flutter: No Dart file ports this — origin: web-only, flutterSources []. Flutter's own MediaQuery.sizeOf(context) / LayoutBuilder are the idiomatic responsive-breakpoint primitives, read synchronously during build rather than through a subscribed hook, so there is no separate useIsMobile-shaped API to diverge from.
api.web: useIsMobile(): boolean returns true when window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)").matches, per hooks/use-mobile.ts lines 3-4 (MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768, QUERY = max-width 767px) and 20-26; the SSR/first-render snapshot is hard-coded false so the server always renders the desktop layout.
api.note: This is a browser platform concern (matchMedia, SSR hydration) with a correct native Flutter equivalent (MediaQuery) rather than a missing port — the origin: web-only contract exists precisely because window.matchMedia and SSR-safe hydration have no Flutter analogue to be a gap against.
